title: Descartes Named to the 2027 FreightWaves FreightTech 25
summary: Descartes is named to FreightWaves' 2027 FreightTech 25 for innovation in freight fraud prevention, real-time visibility and AI transportation management.
body_markdown:
Descartes has been named to the 2027 FreightTech 25, FreightWaves' annual ranking of the most innovative companies in freight technology. The list was announced on October 26, 2026 at the F3 Awards Dinner in Chattanooga, Tennessee.


## **What is the FreightTech 25?**


The[FreightTech 25](https://www.freightwaves.com/news/2027-freighttech-25-winners-announced-at-f3) is chosen from the[FreightTech 100](https://www.freightwaves.com/news/freightwaves-announces-the-2027-freighttech100) , a broader group of companies FreightWaves recognizes each year for innovation in freight and supply chain technology. An independent panel of more than 80 industry executives, academics and investors ranks the 100 companies, and an accounting firm audits the vote to select the top 25.


## **Fraud prevention and AI automation lead the 2027 list**


This year's rankings put heavy weight on two problems freight brokers and shippers face every day: freight fraud and manual work. Both sit at the center of the Descartes transportation management portfolio.


- **Carrier vetting and onboarding.**[Descartes MyCarrierPortal](https://www.mycarrierportal.com/) ™ verifies carrier identity, insurance and authority before a load is tendered, then keeps monitoring carriers for compliance changes.


- **Real-time visibility and fraud detection.**[Descartes MacroPoint](https://www.macropoint.com/) ™ tracks freight across truckload, LTL, ocean, rail, air and parcel. FraudGuard flags spoofed location data, route deviations and VoIP phone numbers in real time.


- **AI-powered brokerage execution.**[Descartes Tai TMS](https://www.tai-software.com/) , which became part of the portfolio in 2026, gives freight brokers an AI-driven TMS that automates freight execution.


- **Transportation management for shippers and 3PLs.**[Descartes Transportation Manager](https://www.descartes.com/solutions/transportation-management) ™ and Descartes[3G TMS](https://www.3gtms.com/) support multimodal planning, execution and carrier management.


> “Being named to the FreightTech 25 is meaningful recognition, especially in a year when fraud prevention and AI automation defined the list,” said Andrew Wimer, Associate General Manager, Transportation Management at Descartes. “These are challenges our customers face every day. By bringing together carrier vetting, real-time visibility and AI-driven execution, we help freight brokers and shippers minimize the risk of fraud before it reaches the load, know where their freight is at every step, and spend less time on manual work.”


## **A track record in freight fraud prevention**


The recognition follows Descartes' selection as a winner of the[2025 FreightWaves Fraud Fighter Awards](https://www.freightwaves.com/news/descartes-protecting-freight-with-advanced-fraud-prevention-technology) , which recognized how Descartes solutions help mitigate fraud at multiple stages of a shipment, from pre-tender vetting through in-transit monitoring.


Read the full[2027 FreightTech 25 list on FreightWaves.](https://www.freightwaves.com/news/2027-freighttech-25-winners-announced-at-f3)

Descartes powers more responsive, efficient, secure, and sustainable international and domestic supply chains by uniting logistics-intensive businesses on its Global Logistics Network (GLN). Shippers, carriers, and logistics service providers connect and collaborate on the GLN, leveraging technology, data, and AI to manage last-mile deliveries, domestic and international shipments, transportation rating and payment, global trade research, customs compliance, and a variety of regulatory processes.
